_transcription: ENGLISH half only. 23 rendered pages. The paper is bilingual with Hindi and English on ALTERNATING pages, Hindi FIRST: idx 0 = cover, idx 1 = Hindi General Instructions, idx 2 = English General Instructions + Q1, then Hindi/English pairs throughout (idx 3 Hindi / idx 4 English, ...). English pages are therefore the EVEN 0-based indices 2..22 — the pilot hypothesis HELD. Section A on idx 2/4/6/8/10, B on 12, C on 14, D on 16, E on 18/20/22. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read verbatim off the marking scheme for this exact paper code (65/2/1, ms/p02..p06); my own derivation agreed with the key on all 20, so no disagreement flags. Decimal points are printed as RAISED dots (0·01, 0·00001%) and are written {\cdot}. MCQ option labels are UPPERCASE (A)-(D); internal-choice sub-labels are lowercase (a)/(b). 'Case Study - 1/2/3' headings ARE printed (en dash) and are recorded in _caseStudyLabel, never in context. Case Study 2 (Q37) has only TWO sub-parts, (i) and (ii), 2 marks each — no (iii) and no internal choice.
